{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping highest sample_seq
df = df.sort_values(by=['patient_id', 'sample_seq'], ascending=[True, False])
df_dedup = df.drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Step 2: Compute response rate using ALL deduplicated patients, including those with baseline -999
# The population is defined as all patients after deduplication, so we must include -999 rows
response_rates_all = df_dedup.groupby('site')['responded'].mean().round(4)

# Step 3: Show the response rates
print(response_rates_all.to_string())"}
